stem: A tree in Dante’s neighborhood grew 18 inches in the first 2 years after it was planted. If the tree continues to grow at this same rate, which graph best represents the growth rate of the tree in inches per year?
visual_elements: Graph F: Growth 90 inches at year 5; linear increasing
Graph H: Vertical line at year 1; no increase over years
Graph G: Growth 90 inches at year 10; linear increasing slower than F
Graph J: Growth 90 inches at year 3; linear increasing faster than F
